name: .243 Cal-071gr Power Hammer™
note: Recommended use: Small to Medium game hunting. The product page also says: "This Power Hammer™ is designed for some of the slow twist rifles out there as well as the more modern fast twist rifles. This bullet has a 2mm hollow point allowing it to open up easily but still retain approximately 90% of it’s original weight. This light weight Power Hammer™ will work very well for those who want less recoil and still hunt small to big game." The product name says 71 gr; the specification says 69 gr.
